prompt: The image is rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the frenetic energy of a beach volleyball tournament. On the left side of the court, a player in a blue jersey leaps high, arm extended to spike the ball. Directly below him, a teammate in white shorts crouches low, ready to dig. To their right, an opponent in a black tank top jumps to block the incoming attack. Behind the net, a referee in a striped shirt stands on a tall chair, watching the play intently. In the foreground sand, a red cooler sits next to a yellow water bottle. A spectator in a wide-brimmed hat points toward the action from the sidelines. Beside this spectator, a child in a pink dress claps hands excitedly. Further back, a man in sunglasses leans against a palm tree trunk. Next to the tree, a brown dog lies sleeping on a towel. Near the center line, a woman in a green visor holds a clipboard tightly. She looks at a scorecard held by an assistant in a grey polo. On the far right side, a vendor in an apron hands a hot dog to a customer in a cap. The customer reaches out to take the food. Nearby, a couple shares an umbrella; the person in the floral shirt sits on a folding chair while the other stands beside them. A lost sandal lies abandoned near the baseline. A whistle hangs around the referee's neck. The net poles are anchored firmly in the sand. There is no ocean visible in the background. There is no scoreboard electronic display present. There is no professional camera equipment shown.
